svg.title: CAP: partitions are not optional, so you are choosing C or A
svg.desc: CAP theorem triangle with consistency, availability and partition tolerance at the vertices. The CP edge means refusing requests during a partition to keep data correct, as in banking. The AP edge means answering with possibly stale data to stay up, as in social feeds. The CA edge is labelled unavailable in any real distributed system because network partitions cannot be prevented.
